init.label: Record cards
init.body:
# One row at a time
The **Record** node shows a single frame row as labeled boxes. The layout is plain text: one line per grid row, names split by `|`; repeating a name merges its cells, and `*2` widens one (the `Photo` box spans all four rows and two columns). The card itself stays compact and carries the chip; the drawn card lands wherever the chart output goes, like the resizable **Display** or the Spec sheet report. Here an **XMATCH** searches the SKU column and drives **Row**, so the card jumps to the matching part; unplug Row to flip records with the pager instead. A cell holding an image URL renders as the picture.

init.label: List view
init.body:
# List view
Every record on one line: the title field, then its other fields indented beneath. The densest way to read a frame.

init.label: Title field
init.body:
# Title field
Prefix a field with `#` in the layout to make it the record's title. It renders large and without its label at the top of every card, in every view.

init.label: Card size
init.body:
# Card size
The `cardsize` option sizes gallery tiles: `s`, `m` or `l`. These are small.

init.label: Clamp long text
init.body:
# Clamp long text
The `clamp` option caps long tile values at three lines with an ellipsis, so the grid stays even. The pop-up still shows the whole card.
